source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Compare the values from the monitoring records to the permitted limits.
3. If the monitoring data exceeds the allowed limits, it is an instance of excess emissions. You should document this.
4. Provide the full monitoring results.
5. Identify the date and time when the excess emission occurred.
6. Describe the nature of the excess emission.
7. Provide the duration of the excess emission.
8. Estimate the amount of pollutant emitted during the excess emission.
9. Explain the cause of the excess emission.
10. Describe any corrective actions taken to address the excess emission.
11. Describe any mitigation measures implemented to minimize the impact of the excess emission.
12. Describe any future preventative measures that will be taken to prevent recurrence of the excess emission.
13. Include any supporting documentation, such as equipment maintenance records and operator logs.

The documentation should be:

*   **Accurate**:
